text:
Maria: oncall-bot triggered: multiple model-serving 5xx spikes across us-west-2, PD noise starting. customers A and B reporting higher latency. paging now.

sre-bot: INCIDENT CREATED - id=INC-2249990123, severity=sev2, affected=redwood-runtime, initial_signal=error-rate>5pct-5m

oncall-bot: @channel oncall shift: Maria -> Ajay (handoff in 2m) :wave:

Maria: quick status: spikes correlate to redis TTL miss storm after a GC window, but still investigating. primary goal: reduce PD noise, keep customers stable.

Ajay: taking over. tagging PD rotation. first mitigation: enable temporary grouping on PD by "error_signature" and set dedupe window to 10m. Can someone flip the grouping rule?

Emily: I can deploy a temporary squelch rule in alert-router. Patch below:

```
# patch: squelch windows
route: /alerts/runtime/5xx
group_by: [error_signature]
dedupe: true
squelch_window: 600s
rate_limit: 20/min
```

Emily: deploying now to staging then prod (ETA 90s).

Lia: adding dashboard note: creating a short-lived tile showing grouped counts + unique error_signature heatmap. Will push in 2m.

Ajay: @Emily do you also have a temporary metric filter we can put on PD to avoid paging on low-impact customers? want to keep PD for top-requests.

Emily: yep — filter: metadata.customer_tier != "free" OR error_rate>0.1. Will attach to PD rule.

Maria: customer impact check: A: intermittent slowdowns for embeddings, B: retry loops causing duplicated downstream traffic. No data exfil/PII. Notified CS.

pd-bot: PagerDuty incident routed to oncall-rule-group: model-serving-errors. Current duplicates: 18/min.

Ajay: Ok after squelch and grouping, we'll observe for 10 min, then open optional rate cap (limit alerts to 5/min). Also plan: reorganize thresholds — raise noisy low-severity thresholds to reduce noise during GC windows.

Lia: pushed dashboard tile, link: https://dashboards.internal/r/inc-2249990123. Added a short explanation and a runbook link.

Emily: prod change applied. squelch window active. PD duplicates dropped immediately.

Maria: nice. immediate mitigation worked. next: post-incident tune plan. I propose 3 workstreams: 1) threshold reorg 2) smarter grouping keys (trace_id + error_signature) 3) short quiet-period policy for infra churn.

Ajay: +1. For grouping keys we should avoid trace_id alone (over-splits). Proposed keys: service+error_signature+root_cause_hash. Will run a 24h dry-run before committing.

Emily: I'll instrument a dry-run mode in alert-router so new grouping won't change PD behavior but will log group counts. Add flag: grouping.dry_run=true.

Lia: for dashboards I'll add a comparison view: current vs dry-run group counts (24h). Helps decide grouping granularity.

Maria: temporary policy: implement a "quiet period" after deploy windows and GC windows where low-sev alerts get rate-limited and annotated. Need ops approval.

Ajay: ops - does quiet period conflict with our SLO alerting? we need to ensure we don't suppress real customer-impacting signals.

Emily: quiet period will only apply to infra-only noise signatures (redis-ttl, gc-spike) and requires an explicit allowlist. We'll keep error-rate and latency SLO alerts untouched.

Lia: Action items - tagging owners: Threshold reorg -> Ajay, Grouping dry-run -> Emily, Dashboards & runbook update -> Lia, PD routing changes -> Maria. ETA: initial PRs by EOD.

Maria: I'll also schedule a 30-min postmortem sync at 1600 to review dry-run results and decide threshold changes. Please bring sample alerts.

pd-bot: PD suppression active: grouping rule applied. Duplicate rate down 80%.

Ajay: note for post-incident notes: add a small experiment — apply rate_limit=10/min for 6 hours during high-churn windows and measure missed real incidents. We'll keep an override to disable instantly.

Emily: logging note: tagging all grouped alerts with tag:inc-2249990123 so we can retrospectively compute false-negative risk.

Lia: I'll update the oncall runbook with a short checklist for "live squelch":
- confirm customer impact
- enable grouping+dedeupe
- enable dashboard tile
- notify CS + PG
- monitor 10m
- escalate if customer-facing errors persist

Maria: thanks all. keep the channel updated. If anyone sees customer-facing regressions unmute PD.

Ajay: quick FYI — after quiet period we should run a script to auto-rollback grouping if unique error_signature drops below threshold. I'll draft that.

Emily: rolling a small canary of the grouping change in staging for 24h then prod dry-run.

Maria: last: post-incident follow-ups (non-blocking): create a permanent metric for "alert-churn-index", precompute suggested thresholds by service, and add a playbook for quiet-period approvals. Assign back to SRE-ops team.

pd-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - noise mitigations reduced PD pages. Monitor window remains open for 2h.

Maria: closing handoff to Ajay for watch. thanks everyone :heart:
